text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm researching something in the library
after
school when Mejiro Ardan walks in.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm fine... Thanks for asking... but
you
needn't worry. I'm used to it.
choice_data_list: Are you okay? Did you feel dizzy?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, there's a book I need
to find.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, here it is. Volume twenty-eight of the Twinkle Series Almanac.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I started reading these on the days I
wasn't
feeling well, and before I knew it,
I was hooked.
choice_data_list: Impressive... You read the whole series?
That's amazing... You read the whole series?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...My body can't handle a lot of strain, so
I
thought I should try to learn more
about racing
through its history instead.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'll do whatever I can... so that one day, I
will
leave my mark on racing history.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
No, it's nothing, really. I just do it
because I want
to.
choice_data_list: You've been working hard even while you couldn't practice, huh.
You've been working hard even while you couldn't practice, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, by the way, are there any books you
would
recommend besides training
guides?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I know there's definitely a book that's
perfect for
someone with a frail
constitution like Mejiro
Ardan. If I recall
correctly, the title should be...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
A cookbook! That sounds wonderful. I
would love
some healthy recipes.
choice_data_list: 'Healthy Athlete Recipes You Can Make in 3 Minutes!'
'Tips for Sound Sleep to Rewire Your Brain'

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'm actually quite the chef despite my

appearance. ♪ My nanny taught me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'll check it out and start reading it
today. I'm sure
I can strengthen my body
with the right diet.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan smiles gently and goes off
to look
for the book.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, interesting... I certainly rest more
than the
average person, so knowing the
best way to sleep
would be a great help.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'm glad I asked you. I'll read it
straight
away and put its teachings into
practice tonight.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure Mejiro Ardan's sleep quality will
improve
with help from the book.
Hopefully that means
her condition will
also get a little better.
